source: Social Health Authority, premium rates (https://sha.go.ke/premium-rates), read 2026-11-05: employers deduct 2.75% of gross salary, minimum 300 a month, no upper limit. The page gives no effective date; October 2024 is from EY (https://www.ey.com/en_gl/technical/tax-alerts/kenya-employers-to-begin-making-contributions-to-social-health-insurance-fund). KRA lists SHIF contributions as deductible for PAYE (https://www.kra.go.ke/individual/filing-paying/types-of-taxes/paye), so deduct it before ke.paye.
